descriptionBody:
CI&T's Data & Analytics practice is scaling its portfolio of data-driven engagements for enterprise clients, and we are looking for an experienced Data Product Manager to lead the full life cycle of our data products. This is a high-visibility leadership role: these positions are historically hard to fill because they demand a genuine technical foundation in data, not just a product or analytics background, and the right professional will directly shape how our data initiatives are prioritized, delivered, and measured.

The Data Product Manager owns data products from ideation through deployment and optimization, combining technical depth, strategic thinking, and people leadership. This role operates at both the strategic level — defining roadmap and priorities with client and business stakeholders — and the operational level, staying close enough to the data architecture and delivery pipeline to make informed, credible decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Data Lifecycle Management: Manage the complete data lifecycle, from data generation through pipelines to data enablement, ensuring each stage supports downstream analytics and consumption.
